title: Opening a filter puts the cursor in its search box
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Reports — Page Access'.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Reports › Sales by Tier.
  2. Open the Customer filter.
  3. Type a.
  4. Open the Category filter.
  5. Type b.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Sales by Tier opens.

Step 2:

  • The cursor blinks in "Search customers".

Step 3:

  • The customer list narrows to names with an a.

Step 4:

  • The cursor blinks in "Search categories".

Step 5:

  • The category list narrows to names with a b.
